combo_label: At the Supermarket × Chocolate & Sweets × Beatrix Potter

entries.clue: Vast out-of-town shed that feeds a hundred branches by nightly lorry
A savoury pinch now finds its way into caramel and other sweet fillings
Fizzing sweet powder that tingles and foams on the tongue
Wheeled basket on four wobbly castors, often freed by a pound coin
Deep amber sweet, boiled hard yet sticky enough to glue the jaws shut
Come Christmas, a family works through this plastic drum of chocolates
Nursery word for a rabbit; the obedient sort went down the lane for blackberries
Cousin in clogs who came down the pear tree and left with onions for his aunt
Bundle of cotton strings on a long handle, wrung out in a wheeled bucket
Well-behaved sister rabbit whose name titles a tale of six sleepy youngsters
